posture.demand: Source frame is the Action Model system-map industry slug law_firms: taxonomy reference only, not client demand or implementation proof. Law firms are the N1 research pilot.
posture.automation: An occupational task inventory (O*NET) identifies legal-assistant document preparation, records organisation and research. A preregistered 2024 study found errors in the legal AI research tools it tested despite retrieval grounding. This supports decomposing tasks and measuring supervised assistance; it does not supply a law-firm-wide automation rate. forecast_percent: null.
posture.ceiling: This is not legal advice, product admission or an industry-wide value forecast. Current software adoption and subscription prices were not verified; named offerings are not assumed installed. No claim that a generic repository replaces the whole practice stack.

processes.boundary: Collect and normalise supplied fields; flag missing facts and possible matches; never accept a conflict or engagement automatically.
processes.metric: Human minutes per complete, accepted intake including review and chase
processes.falsifier: Reject if a known conflict/identity ambiguity is suppressed or completed intake takes no less total human time.
processes.authority: Firm-designated intake reviewer; lawyer owns conflict/engagement decision.

processes.boundary: Populate approved templates from validated interview answers and return a draft plus field provenance.
processes.metric: Human minutes per correct, reviewed document; critical field errors
processes.falsifier: Reject if reviewed documents take no less human time or critical field errors rise.
processes.authority: Lawyer approves templates and every outgoing document.

processes.boundary: Extract and annotate with citations back to the source document; the reviewer decides.
processes.metric: Correct accepted findings per reviewer hour, with unsupported findings counted
processes.falsifier: Reject if unsupported findings reach a filing or reviewer hours do not fall.

processes.boundary: Route approved documents for signature and track completion; no document is altered.
processes.metric: Human coordination minutes per correctly completed signing workflow
processes.falsifier: Reject if an unapproved document is sent or coordination minutes do not fall.

processes.boundary: Draft approved-status updates from case state; a human sends.
processes.metric: Net human minutes per accurate approved update, including exceptions
processes.falsifier: Reject if an inaccurate update reaches a client or net minutes do not fall.

processes.boundary: Surface exceptions against firm rules; billing staff resolve.
processes.metric: Review minutes per resolved exception; correction rate; actual recovered or avoided spend
processes.falsifier: Reject if exceptions are auto-resolved or review minutes do not fall.

offer.what: A supervised operating layer over the firm's existing software: intake normalisation and chase, approved-template assembly, citation-linked document review, signing coordination, approved client updates, billing-exception review. Each process carries a metric, a falsifier and a named human authority; the offer is sold on measured human minutes and first-year net cash in one authorised firm, never on a chart.
offer.pilot: Within one authorised firm, compare matched routine work under the incumbent workflow and the supervised candidate workflow. Start with synthetic/redacted fixtures; pre-register which documents/actions are in scope before using live data.
record: assisted human minutes including review and rework

reject_if: Human time including review/rework is not lower than the matched baseline.
Any privileged record crosses an unauthorised boundary or an unapproved external action occurs.
The result depends on treating draft/closed status as accepted legal work.
Measured first-year net cash is not positive for a cash-savings offer; capacity gains alone are not cash.
value_reason: No firm baseline, invoices, achieved automation rate, review/rework time, operating cost, displacement proof or eligible-population measurement. Null is not zero. Formula: observed-value-v0.1; every process row carries status: unmeasured.
